record.name: Sipho Ndlovu
record.summary: I have worked in sales for about ten years, mostly selling groceries and cleaning products to spaza shops, small supermarkets and restaurants. At Mzansi Cash and Carry I was the top rep in my region for three years running and I looked after about 120 accounts. Before that I worked for Tswane Wholesalers from 2013 to 2017 doing the same kind of work. I use a CRM every day to log visits and I am comfortable negotiating prices and promotions. I have a code 08 licence and my own bakkie. I finished matric at Pretoria Boys in 2009. I am good at Excel and I speak English, Zulu and Sotho.
